dropzones.name: Sportski aerodrom Stenkovec

dropzones.status_evidence: Club pages (aeroklubskopje.mk, aeroclub.mk, lwsn.mk) offer tandem jumps and say beginner courses run each spring and autumn, but none is dated; aeroclub.mk footer reads 2023. The newest dated jumping evidence found is a March 2023 training report (fakulteti.mk). Airfield documents revised in 2025 are not evidence of jumps.
